notes.title: Fat Goblins Bot & Stability Playtest! June 27-30
notes.notes: [h3]When[/h3][p]Fri June 27, 14:00 PDT (UTC-7) → Sun June 30, 14:00 PDT[/p][p][/p][h3]Where[/h3][p]Request access on the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2450350/Fat_Goblins/"]Fat Goblins Steam Page[/url] and download the build when the playtest opens[/p][p][/p][h3]What's being tested[/h3][list][*][p]Network stability[/p][list][*][p]New server cluster + congestion fixes[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Steamworks integration[/p][list][*][p]Friend invites, lobby parties, rich presence[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Voice chat[/p][list][*][p]Proximity goblin-styled voice chat[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Death voice chat[/p][list][*][p]Hear peoples reactions if opted-in when they die[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]AI bots[/p][list][*][p]Prototype goblin bots fill empty slots for matchmaking[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New dungeon map[/p][list][*][p]Potentially testing the new dungeon map with the PvPvE dragon boss[/p][/*][*][p]This might not make it into this upcoming playtest, we will see[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]How to help[/h3][olist][*][p]Join anytime during the 72-hour window and play a few matches[/p][/*][*][p]If you hit disconnects or glitches, post in the [url="https://discord.gg/MyrYGj5cHQ"]Fat Goblins Discord[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Drop additional feedback in [url="https://discord.gg/MyrYGj5cHQ"]Fat Goblins Discord[/url][/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]See you on the battlefield![/p]
